## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated formatting.
- [ ] User-facing behavior is documented when needed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated for user-visible changes.
- [ ] The app still processes files locally.
- [ ] No telemetry, account login, credential access, or file upload behavior was added.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes were reviewed against `SECURITY.md`.
